note: Set B's wiring-schedule claims are consistently bound to the right symbols and descriptions (34, 50, 150, 31, 32, 33) and its title-block/revision and copyright claims match the page. Set A gets several schedule entries right too, but it also invents or misbinds multiple claims: a quote 'NEMA ENCLOSURE, SNAP MAIN BREAKER' that does not exist on the page, '100A' which appears nowhere, '60A DC MIDS' misread from '60A DC NFDS' and attributed to Note 4 instead of Note 5, and calls for components 7, 50 and a 20 A breaker that are actually note/wiring-symbol numbers. B's weaknesses are redundancy (34 and 150 repeated) and a few trivial or weakly supported callout claims, but it has far fewer substantive errors.
